verses.raw: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient,
verses.text: And We will surely test you with something of fear and hunger and a loss of wealth and lives and fruits, but give good tidings to the patient,

verses.raw: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return."
verses.text: Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return."

verses.raw: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided.
verses.text: Those are the ones upon whom are blessings from their Lord and mercy. And it is those who are the [rightly] guided.
